status: FROZEN before tailCfft2000 was trained and before any forecast of it existed. The SHA-256 of this file is recorded in the commit that froze it. Amendments only before any result is seen.
title: Pavo with Bris's spectral term: does it keep Pavo's heavy-rain gain over the control arm with the spectral term, with realistic fields?
origin: With the spectral term restored, the control arm (controlfft2000) improved by -4.3 % at 20 mm and its fields came back to Bris's spectrum. Against it, Pavo (no spectral term) was still better after calibration, -0.00060 [-0.00113, -0.00005] (-2.9 %), with ROC area 0.908 against 0.863, but with noisy fields and too much rain; A + spectral was not better than it (+0.9 %, interval across zero) and its precipitation became too smooth. This plan adds the spectral term to Pavo.

models.tailCfft2000: bris/train/finetune_tail_c_spectral.yaml: finetune_tail_c plus xbris.spectral.SpectralAlmostFairKernelCRPS, loss_weights [1.0, 0.1, 39.09], seed 20260909, step 2000
models.controlfft2000: the control arm with the spectral term, seed 20260909, step 2000, already forecast for the test year
models.tailC2000: Pavo, seed 20260909, already forecast for the test year

training: one run, bris/slurm/finetune.sbatch finetune_tail_c_spectral, on an H200 whenever one is free; queued 2026-10-28 behind other users' jobs. A run lost to the node is restarted from the beginning, unchanged.
test: exactly as evaluation/control_spectral_plan.json: 2025-08-01..2026-09-06, 4 members, BRIS_LEADTIMES=7, +30 h, strict common cases of the models and MEPS, scripts/hits_and_calibration.py --cv month --replicates 5000 --meps.

primary_endpoint.measure: Brier score at 20 mm per day after month-out isotonic calibration, tailCfft2000 minus controlfft2000
primary_endpoint.uncertainty: paired block bootstrap, seven-day blocks, 5000 replicates
primary_endpoint.positive_if: the upper 95 percent bound is below 0
primary_endpoint.negative_if: the lower 95 percent bound is above 0

registered_expectation: scripts/spectra.py, every 12th day, +36 h: tailCfft2000's small-scale variance (5-20 km) for wind and precipitation lies between 0.8 and 1.2 of the analysis', where Pavo's was 1.25-1.48 (wind) and 1.32-1.41 (precipitation). Reported whichever way it goes.
secondary_reported: tailCfft2000 minus tailC2000, calibrated and raw, at 20 mm: what the spectral term does to Pavo
raw Brier at 20 mm against controlfft2000, with its sign and a paired block bootstrap
the same at 10 and 50 mm; ROC area; frequency bias; mean precipitation over all station-days
operational calibration (--cv past) against controlfft2000 if validation forecasts of both exist
